text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAAAARRGHH――!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihi, Maya won!
I actually won~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heheh, with this—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Still not enough, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mayano! Well done!
That final stretch was brilliant as always!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, Hishi Ama-san?
Were you watching us?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! It's a big match day, after all,
so I came to cheer—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Then please, I want you to teach me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What race is Brian-san running in next?
You'd know, right, Hishi Ama-san?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you've got me beat. Are you
still not satisfied yet?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But still...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't even look frustrated yet.
If anything, she looks sad.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I really don't like that idea. If we're gonna compete, then—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants to sparkle so bright
that they'll be even more jealous of Maya.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ha, reminds me of when I first met that guy.
Even right after a race, he still had
that totally starved look on his face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll tell you.
My gut says it's the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day,
she craves a stage where only the strongest gather.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You were probably looking at this Hanshin Daishoten
as just a stepping stone toward the Tenno Sho (Spring) all along, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Spring).
A prestigious, traditional race contending for the pinnacle of long-distance glory.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-chan.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go for the Tenno Sho (Spring).
Yeah, let's go for the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eye copy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heh... What an impressive bunch, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm already on board!
Might as well tag along for the ride!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, once we get back today, I'm gonna drill
you even harder! Hope you're ready!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nihihi, of cooourse☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next goal was set
on the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
